svg.aria-label: Cost-routing press: a hopper feeds coding tasks down a chute onto a sorting drum, a press stamps each task, and a channel carries it into one of three bins — small cheap Flash bin, mid bin, large premium flagship bin — while a budget gauge and a lit STOP lever latch down when the team's ACU budget runs out. SWE-2 Flash is about 3x faster at about 1/5 the price of the SWE-2 flagship; Fable 5.2 leads FrontierCode 2.0 at 49.1; hierarchical budgets run 1 root budget up to 3 levels deep.
svg.text: cost-routing press: Devin Fable 5.2 + SWE-2 Flash
3x faster · 1/5 price · 3 levels deep · 49.1 FrontierCode · $8/$40 per 1M
